description: Four compare entry points describe one operation four ways and only Query names the 4-run ceiling. BenchmarkIndex.tsx:129 says 'Select two or more platforms' (states a floor, omits the ceiling). PlatformIndex renders THREE simultaneous status surfaces - the guidance card :152, the table header count :716, and a leftover paragraph :848 - which at exactly one selection say the same thing three times in three wordings. Query.tsx:834 is the only correct one ('4 results selected (maximum)'). The Compare builder states 'two to four runs' in its intro at :916 then drops the ceiling from the live status at :984. Separately, once a selection becomes valid, BenchmarkIndex.tsx:684 and PlatformIndex.tsx:665 replace the Compare button with a non-interactive span reading 'Use sticky tray to compare', and aria-live=polite sits on THAT static span (:687 and :668) while the guidance paragraph that actually changes on every selection has no live region at all. lib/copyFormatters.ts:35 already exports formatSelectedCount(count, noun). Verified at HEAD 39ead3a41.
